general_notes: Each state used the same six treatments in shuffled order: (1) target inside an added dark border frame (near-identical); (2) target heavily blurred; (3) cut-out on near-black with soft halo (3 copies); (4) cut-out on light grey (3 copies); (5) zoomed crop inside a dark round vignette that cuts off legs/feet; (6) a different 3D/vector render. Copies within the same treatment looked identical or nearly so to me and got identical scores; tiny differences between them may exist below what I could see at this resolution. Light-background cut-outs suffer most on P2/P3 and flame colour; dark cut-outs keep the character but lose the painted backdrop and some flame wisps/smoke (worst in depleted, where the smoke plume nearly disappears). In the depleted target there is a flat grey rectangle at lower right that looks like an artifact in the reference itself; the light cut-outs turn it into a dark blob near the feet.
